_comment: Default configuration for the elasticsearch addon. Override any key in app-custom-config.json.
_comment_sist2_url: No default (#1186). Set to the sist2 HTTP address, e.g. http://192.168.68.71:4090, and add that LAN prefix to ngdpbase.security.egress.allowed-ranges. localhost / 127.0.0.1 are never permitted by the egress guard. Empty = search only; thumbnails and file serving off.
